verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a managed streaming service, but the evidence pack shows no Amazon IVS natural-language interface, assistant, or agent. The pack documents only conventional APIs, SDKs, CLI flags and EventBridge rules. The AWS-wide llms.txt file is a documentation-access aid on the host platform, not a way to operate IVS with natural-language commands, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
